==Biography==
Peter '''"Mellisan"''' Meisrimel is from Kassel, Germany. He started playing League of Legends in December of 2009.

== Trivia ==
* Renowned for his Janna play.
* Was a professional player in Guild Wars before League of Legends. 
* Retired to focus on university, studying Mathematics.
* Introduced to [http://www.fnatic.com/content/95800 Fnatic's Hall of Fame] on November 12, 2013.
